sources.quote: During the past decade, the state has issued GPC 38 notices of violation related to air pollution
sources.searcher_note: Same Muscatine plant, same theme (many violations, weak Iowa DNR follow-through: penalties on two occasions, $548,000), but window is 2001-2011, before the lead's 2015-25 window.

sources.quote: People living near the plant filed the lawsuit in 2012 saying GPC failed to control emissions.
sources.searcher_note: Neighbors' class action over GPC Muscatine emissions; same plant, different finding (nuisance suit, not stack tests or state orders).

sources.quote: Based on data from recent stack tests, the exhaust air flow rate is modified for both stacks, the emission limit for PM and PM10 is increased for EP135.0
sources.searcher_note: DNR permit notice (Project 25-329): GPC Muscatine's #4 Maltrin Spray Dryer PM limit raised after stack tests. Names the entity and stack tests; does not report failures or orders.

notes: No source found that reports GPC Muscatine's 49 failed stack-test days in 2015-25, its rank among wet corn mills, the 36 violations with 0 state orders, or the Iowa (19) vs Indiana (572) statewide order gap. Older coverage of the same plant is plentiful but pre-window: Iowa AG sued GPC in Dec 2011; 2014 consent decree with $1.5M penalty and coal-to-gas conversion (search snippets, Iowa Environmental Focus / Federal Register 2018 ACO amendment, not fetched). EPA Region 7 NOV on Clean Air Act issues dated 2012-03-27 (archive.epa.gov PDF, scanned, not quotable). Indiana twin: IDEM agreed orders 2017-24358-A, 2019-26677-A, 2020-27370-A for GPC Washington IN surfaced in search, but every in.gov/idem/oe/cause page returned HTTP 404 on fetch, so no quote; no news coverage of the Indiana orders or the $687,030 found. A search snippet said GPC failed to keep a scrubber Air:Water ratio for 34 days in 2025, but the PDFs it could come from (EPA permit 15-A-480, IDEM 2025 compliance certification) did not parse, so it is not recorded. Muscatine Journal pages redirect to a bot paywall (tollbit).
